# Room conversation (#4790, #4791, #4793)

Retention: retained as bounded before/after review evidence for #4790, #4791 and #4793. Replace only with superseding reviewed evidence.

Images live on the orphan branch `pr-assets/room-conversation-4810`, pinned at commit `dd6aa8733b55` (repository PNGs are ignored by `.gitignore`); `receipt.json` lists each file's SHA-256.

Before: today's Project room and Task room components (origin/main `c493a11367da`) rendered through this PR's room gallery scenes and fixtures. After: the shared `RoomConversation` and `RoomComposer` at `0a51d314ad9b`, merged with origin/main `e5b5bd24e1ae`, including the #4810 review fixes. Both are local captures of the same 32 scenes on an isolated e2e Station; every PNG was opened at 390 and 1440 in both themes. Times follow the capturing host's time zone.

These scenes are new, so there is no tracked baseline and no pixel comparison (`NOT_VERIFIED: 32 new / 0 comparisons`). They are visual receipts, not a full-gallery qualification, and they do not cover native shells or physical devices. Reactions have no scene: no room contract carries them yet.

[Design sketch](design-sketch.md) written before implementation.
